Stella, San Carlo all'Arena (Municipalità 3) — Naples, Italy

Average day Average night

In detail

Home to Rione Sanità, historically one of Naples' most stigmatised neighbourhoods and now in the middle of a genuine, widely covered cultural revival — community-led tours, restored catacombs and churches, and a growing arts scene (the 2025 "Sanità TàTà" festival among other initiatives). Coverage is honest about the area still being in transition rather than fully resolved: at least one investigative piece from 2024 reports organised crime interests moving into the same tourism economy that is driving the neighbourhood's rebirth, rather than disappearing outright. No specific stese hotspot naming for this Municipalità was found (unlike Municipalità 2, 4, 6, 7 and 9), consistent with a genuinely improving but not yet fully resolved picture. Sources checked: BuoneNotizie.it, 10 May 2024 (Rione Sanità revival); CronacheDi.it, 2024 (camorra and tourism economy in Rione Sanità).
